title: BigCodeArena: Unveiling More Reliable Human Preferences in Code Generation via Execution
authors_zh: Terry Yue Zhuo、Xiaolong Jin、Hange Liu 等
paper_type_zh: 执行增强的多轮代码偏好数据集、奖励模型评测与基准
best_for_zh: 训练或审计代码奖励模型、代码偏好优化和执行感知评测的研究者
one_line: BigCodeArena couples human code preferences with execution to make code-feedback labels more reliable.
BigCodeArena 把可交互的代码执行结果接入人类两两偏好收集，使代码奖励模型能同时利用行为证据与用户判断。
why: It joins subjective feedback to a programmatic correctness surface.
inclusion_reason: Public code preference data grounded by execution evidence.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Human preference is valuable for judging code-generating systems, but users cannot reliably assess a long program by reading it alone. A response may look clean, persuasive, or stylistically attractive while failing to run, producing the wrong output, or behaving incorrectly in its intended framework. Conversely, a correct answer can be penalized when its execution behavior is invisible to the person making the comparison. Pure text-side preference collection therefore confounds subjective presentation with program behavior.

The problem is to collect code-generation feedback in an environment where people can inspect and interact with execution outcomes while still expressing human preferences about usability, explanation, and workflow. The feedback object must connect an instruction, competing code responses, execution environment and results, multi-turn interaction, and a human choice. Such data can separate what execution verifies from the residual judgments that still require people, and can reveal preferences that vary by programming language, task type, and framework.

人类偏好对判断代码生成系统很有价值，但用户无法仅靠阅读长程序就可靠地评估质量。一个回答可能整洁、说服力强或风格美观，却无法运行、产生错误输出，或在目标框架中行为错误；反过来，正确答案也可能因执行行为不可见而被低估。纯文本侧的偏好收集因此会混淆主观呈现与程序行为。

问题在于如何在用户能查看并交互执行结果的环境中收集代码生成反馈，同时保留人类对可用性、解释与工作流的偏好。反馈对象应连接指令、竞争代码回答、执行环境和结果、多轮交互及人工选择。这类数据能够区分由执行验证的部分和仍需人类判断的部分，也能揭示随编程语言、任务类型和框架变化的偏好。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
BigCodeArena turns code execution into part of the human preference-collection interface: users compare anonymized model responses after seeing and interacting with their runtime behavior. A record ties the task, multi-turn dialogue, two candidate programs, sandbox environment and outputs, optional interaction traces, and a four-way vote; execution is behavioral evidence while humans still decide overall preference. The closest comparison is text-only Chatbot Arena-style voting; this work changes the observation surface from static code to executable artifacts. It is a Track 02 resource because the released object is human preference data, later consumed by BigCodeReward for reward-model evaluation.

Open data: BigCodeArena preference subset — https://huggingface.co/datasets/bigcode/bigcodearena-preference-5k. The official BigCode collection also releases the 14K raw sessions and the BigCodeReward derivative; code is at https://github.com/bigcode-project/bigcodearena.

BigCodeArena 把代码执行纳入人工偏好收集界面：用户在查看并交互运行行为后比较匿名模型回答。一条记录连接任务、多轮对话、两个候选程序、沙箱环境和输出、可选交互轨迹及四类投票；执行提供行为证据，而总体偏好仍由人作出。最接近的对照是 Chatbot Arena 式纯文本投票；该工作把观察表面从静态代码改为可执行产物。它属于 Track 02，因为发布对象是人类偏好数据，随后被 BigCodeReward 用于奖励模型评测。

公开数据：BigCodeArena 偏好子集 — https://huggingface.co/datasets/bigcode/bigcodearena-preference-5k。官方 BigCode 集合还发布 14K 原始会话和 BigCodeReward 派生产物；代码位于 https://github.com/bigcode-project/bigcodearena。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Input: receive a code-oriented task and candidate responses from competing LLMs across supported languages and execution environments.
  1. Execution: run the generated code on demand, expose outputs and execution behavior, and let the user interact with that evidence during a multi-turn session.
  1. Preference collection: record the user’s pairwise choice after comparison, together with the code conversation and execution context.
  1. Dataset construction: retain raw sessions, identify preference-bearing multi-turn conversations, and post-process a preference subset for reward-model evaluation.
  1. Evaluation use: compare reward-model judgments with human choices, and build execution-aware automatic evaluation from the collected surface.
  1. Stop rule: execution success is evidence rather than a complete quality label; preserve task, environment, and human preference instead of treating passing behavior as universally preferred code.

1. 输入：接收代码任务及来自竞争 LLM 的候选回答，覆盖支持的语言和执行环境。
  1. 执行：按需运行生成代码，展示输出和执行行为，并允许用户在多轮会话中基于这些证据交互。
  1. 偏好收集：比较后记录用户的两两选择，以及代码对话和执行语境。
  1. 数据构造：保留原始会话，识别包含偏好的多轮对话，并后处理出用于奖励模型评测的偏好子集。
  1. 评测用途：比较奖励模型判断和人类选择，并从收集表面构建执行感知的自动评测。
  1. 停止条件：执行成功只是证据，不是完整质量标签；应保留任务、环境和人类偏好，而非把通过运行视为普适偏好的代码。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The collection demonstrates feasibility at realistic scale: after more than five months of deployment, BigCodeArena recorded over 14,123 conversations from more than 500 unique IP addresses. It covers 10 frontier LLMs, 10 programming languages, and 8 execution environments. For reliable comparison, the authors filter out conversations with fewer than two turns or without code execution, yielding 4,731 voting samples; every evaluated model receives at least 700 votes. The paper also compares code judges with and without execution information and reports that most judges become more reliable when execution results are available. These results support execution-grounded preference collection and reward-model evaluation, not the stronger claim that passing execution fully captures code quality, security, or user intent.

该收集在真实规模上证明可行：部署超过五个月后，BigCodeArena 记录了来自 500 多个唯一 IP 地址的 14,123 条以上对话，覆盖 10 个前沿 LLM、10 种编程语言和 8 类执行环境。为获得可靠比较，作者滤除少于两轮或没有代码执行的对话，得到 4,731 个投票样本；每个被评测模型至少获得 700 票。论文还比较代码评审器在有无执行信息时的判断，报告大多数评审器在看到执行结果后更可靠。这些结果支持以执行为基础收集偏好和评测奖励模型，但不支持“通过执行已完整刻画代码质量、安全性或用户意图”的更强主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is Chatbot Arena-style pairwise voting, where people judge static text responses. BigCodeArena changes the decision surface by letting users execute, inspect, edit, and interact with candidate code before choosing, while logging the environment and multi-turn context. This is a direction signal because code reward models can be audited against preferences informed by observable behavior rather than source text alone. Its quality signal is the deployed public platform and 4,731 execution-bearing votes retained for ranking. Pairwise voting and code sandboxes are not new independently; their integration into an open multi-turn preference release is the changed object. Reusers must retain execution context instead of flattening records into code-only pairs.

最接近的基线是 Chatbot Arena 式两两投票，用户只能判断静态文本回答。BigCodeArena 改变了决策表面：用户可在选择前执行、查看、编辑和交互候选代码，并记录环境与多轮语境。它提示代码奖励模型应接受由可观察行为支撑的偏好审计，而不是仅凭源代码文本。已部署的公开平台和用于排序的 4,731 个含执行投票是质量信号。两两投票和代码沙箱各自都不新，把二者整合为开放的多轮偏好发布才是改变后的对象。复用者必须保留执行语境，不能把记录压扁为纯代码对。

title: Limitations
局限
html: If users vote after exploring only a narrow part of a program, labels can miss latent failures; check interaction traces, task coverage, and whether execution exercised the claimed behavior. If a sandbox differs from deployment, passing results may not transfer; check dependencies, runtime version, resource limits, and framework configuration. If records are flattened into code-only pairs, the execution evidence that motivated the vote is lost; retain environment, outputs, and multi-turn context for training or audit.
若用户只探索程序的很小部分就投票，标签可能遗漏潜在故障；应检查交互轨迹、任务覆盖和执行是否触及所声称行为。若沙箱不同于部署环境，通过运行可能无法迁移；应检查依赖、运行时版本、资源限制和框架配置。若把记录压扁为纯代码对，会丢失促成投票的执行证据；训练或审计时应保留环境、输出和多轮语境。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The intended user is a code-model or reward-model researcher. The task is to test whether a judge, reranker, or preference learner agrees with users after they observed executable behavior. Input is the released preference subset with code, conversation, environment, and output fields. Evaluate a judge with and without execution context, or train while preserving provenance and split boundaries. Output is execution-aware preference accuracy, calibration, or error analysis. Success means improved agreement without hiding environment-specific failures. Do not use the release as a security certification suite, a substitute for integration testing, or a universal measure of production code quality.
适用用户是代码模型或奖励模型研究者。任务是检验评审器、重排器或偏好学习器能否在用户已观察可执行行为后仍与其判断一致。输入为含代码、对话、环境和输出字段的偏好子集；可在有无执行语境下评估评审器，或在保留来源和切分边界后训练。输出是执行感知的偏好准确率、校准或错误分析。成功标准是在不掩盖环境特定故障的前提下提升一致性。不可将该数据当作安全认证、完整集成测试替代品或生产代码质量的普适尺度。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: 1. Execution is an observation channel, not a complete reward. 2. Keep the four-way vote semantics instead of forcing every record into a binary win. 3. Preserve sandbox and output fields with the preference label. 4. Compare reward judges with and without execution evidence. 5. Audit splits for repeated tasks, frameworks, and conversations before training.
1. 执行是观察通道，不是完整奖励。2. 保留四类投票语义，不可把每条记录强制转为二元胜负。3. 将沙箱和输出字段与偏好标签一同保留。4. 比较评审器在有无执行证据时的表现。5. 训练前审计重复任务、框架和对话的切分。
